lyrics.text: Shri Guru Charan Saroj Raj, Nija Manu Mukuru Sudhari
Barnau Raghuvar Bimal Jash, Jo Dayaku Phala Chari
Buddhi Heen Tanu Janike, Sumirau Pavan Kumar
Bal Buddhi Vidya Dehu Mohi, Harahu Klesh Vikar
Jai Hanuman Gyan Gun Sagar, Jai Kapis Tihun Lok Ujagar
Ram Doot Atulit Bal Dhama, Anjani Putra Pavan Sut Nama
Om Namah Shivaya Har Har Bhole Namah Shivaya
Rameshwaraya Shiva Rameshwaraya, Har Har Bhole Namah Shivaya
Gangadharaya Shiva Gangadharaya, Har Har Bhole Namah Shivaya
Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah, Tat Savitur Varenyam
Bhargo Devasya Dheemahi, Dhiyo Yo Nah Prachodayat
